profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I’m a self-motivated creator driven by curiosity with a passion for learning new skills and helping others. Being naturally inquisitive means I’m always looking for a new challenge to hurdle or new skill to learn. I thoroughly enjoy the process of fostering an idea to life and am at my best when I’m problem-solving alongside a team to achieve great solutions.

Interested in working together? Feel free to drop me a line! I look forward to connecting with you.
_____________________________________________________________________________________________________

Back End Skills: Golang, NodeJS, SQL (PostgresSQL/MySQL), Kubernetes, Docker, AWS (S3, SNS, SQS, EKS, API Gateway), Distributed Systems - Microservices & Service Oriented Architecture, Azure AKS, Google GKE, MongoDB

Front End Skills: JavaScript, React, Redux, HTML, CSS

Soft Skills: Quick Learner, Strong communicator, Team player, Adaptive, Organized, Empathy, Dependable

positions.title: Backend Software Engineer (Containers Allocation Data Pipeline)
positions.description:
In April 2021, I transferred to a team that maintained a Data pipeline written in Golang. The pipeline empowers our customers to gain visibility into their company’s resource usage spending and helps them optimize their cloud cost. My contributions included:
- Leading and shadowing several rounds of associate level, behavioral and technical interviews
- Participated in cross-team efforts to maintain standards in Go services (ie: keeping services up to date with latest Go version, updating services with latest internal service versions)
- Peer-mentored my colleagues including being an onboarding buddy for a couple of new hires
- Participated in reviewing PRs inside my team and across the Cloudability organization
- Participated in on-call rotational duties (ie: spinning up more pods when a part of the pipeline needed more workers, moving DLQs back to their main messaging queues, etc)

Examples of Specific Features Implemented:
- Helped implement a new microservice to filter data and reduce the workload on our pipeline to help it run efficiently.
- Led a project to upgrade our open source software to be compatible with the most recent version of Kubernetes, 1.21. Our open source software collects container metrics data that feeds the entire cost allocation Kubernetes engine (cake) data pipeline. While going through this upgrade process, I documented how to test new K8s versions in our supported cloud providers (AWS, AKS, and GCP) for posterity. In addition, I created a detailed process doc that solidified the testing/release flow for  future devs to follow when upgrading the software to new K8s versions.
- Investigated security vulnerabilities thrown in our open source software and built out a JIRA epic to ticket out the work needing to remediate the vulnerabilities. I completed some tasks and helped get other engineers up to speed quickly to fix the vulnerabilities in a timely manner.
- Helped convert our Anomalies service to handle different types of currency codes.

positions.title: Fullstack Software Engineer (User/Org Authentication & Authorization)
positions.description:
I worked on various features to support crucial post-acquisition efforts to integrate our startup’s technology into our newfound parent company. This included:
- Maintaining a variety of services that handled user authentication and authorization, reporting, automated emails, key application features (dashboards, business mappings, etc), & a DB service that gave access to key user and organization information to other teams
- Migrating legacy code to new standard
- Shadowed rounds of intern level technical interviews
- Participated in reviewing PRs inside my team and across Cloudability
- Helped socialize processes (ie: deploy flow, etc) in service slack channels
- Fixing bugs in a timely manner to improve our customer’s user experience
- Improved error handling and logging for increased satisfaction in our developer experience

Examples of Features Implemented:
- Helped implement the first iteration of Enterprise Access Control which gated features. I helped gate features on our frontend, implemented a new customer impersonation standard, modified our user API to lookup users by their Frontdoor-specific username, & migrated our legacy codebase to use our new authorization service which communicated with Frontdoor.
- Refactored our email service and standardized its API endpoints. In this service, I implemented ESLint throughout, added its first unit tests, and migrated legacy emails into using this service.
- Refactored legacy user/org settings and preferences endpoints to more modular APIs and moved them into our new API standard. Then updated the new APIs to integrate with our rollout of Enterprise Access Control and hold Frontdoor specific values.
- Worked cross-functionally and built a user sync poller. It integrated into Apptio’s Product Provisioning Orchestration process that performed CRUD operations for user creation, deletion, and handling updates to keep our Cloudability database in-line with Frontdoor.

positions.title: Fullstack Junior Web Developer/Junior Product Owner
positions.description:
In addition to my developer tasks (listed below in my LinkedIn timeline), I took on the role as Junior Product Owner for our claim processing product. I accomplished the following:
- Increased communication between team and users.
- Made decisions about what features to implement. Broke up large features into smaller tasks to ship incrementally with a future goal in mind.
- Helped build business processes to make our work flow more effective.
- Lead planning meetings to discuss new feature requests with users.
- Maintained sprint schedule and JIRA tasks.

positions.title: Fullstack Junior Web Developer
positions.description:
I implemented impactful features to the codebase in a fast paced start up environment. We increased our processing capabilities from roughly 2,000 claims a month at the beginning of the year to our current capacity of around 17,000 claims a month with the aid of our automation features. 
- Maintained & implemented features for our claim processing product.
- Went through the whole process of implementing features. This included planning, implementing, testing, migrating, documentation, user acceptance, and deploying.
- Mentored new developers in Go and getting to know our codebase. Our team paired often and working together was always valued.
- Participated in support duties on a rotational basis.

Examples of Specific Features Implemented:
- Added functionality to parse EDI data files
- Reorganized entire file loading Go application into single responsibility packages.
- Helped create an in-depth algorithm for patient matching.
- Converted Go’s CSV library to use multiple characters as a delimiter
(natively it only supports runes).
- Added ESLint and Prettify to entire front end codebase.

positions.title: Freelance Fullstack JavaScript Developer
positions.description:
ACCEPTABLE LOSSES

Never get surprised by a bill again! Acceptable Losses allows you to track your expenses, vizualize your total monthly expenses in different formats, and get reminder emails when they're due. This app was built by myself and 4 other developers. My role was predominately Web Designer and Front End Developer.

Tech Stack: React, Redux, JavaScript, HTML/CSS Modules, Redux Form, React Router, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Mongoose, Passport, JWT, Mocha/Chai, Enzyme, Moment, Nivo, Cron, NodeMailer, & more 

------------------------------------------
B MOVIE BINGO

Make watching B Movies more enjoyable with B Movie Bingo, based on the game originally created by Wolf Choir LLC, a group of B Movie fanatics right here in Portland. Plug in a B Movie and watch with your friends. Look out for popular B Movie cliches and mark them off on your card when you see them in action!

Tech Stack: VueJS, Vue Router, HTML & CSS

positions.title: Graphic Artist
positions.description: I designed in-house marketing materials for the NSM Concordia store. I had the opportunity to pilot this position at Concordia. It was my responsibility to build systems that would make this position successful.  I created a communication framework for sign requests and created administrative materials that could be utilized on a company-wide basis. I fostered relationships that facilitated communication between Concordia and NSM Store Support. I also aided in the development of the graphic artist program at other NSM locations by providing training and mentoring for new artists.

positions.title: Produce Clerk/Baker
positions.description:
I was a baker from June 2013 - April 2014. I made all NSM breads including mixing, shaping, bake off, and setting up for the next day. I helped maintain a daily mix schedule that fit the demands of each day as well as helping other coworkers with their assigned tasks.

I was a produce clerk from April 2014 - May 2016. I gave excellent customer service to NSM patrons and assisted in rotating, stocking, cleaning, sign making, and merchandising produce displays. I was also a value added clerk where I assisted in the production of all NSM value added produce. 

During my tenure in these positions, I also took the initiative to be cross-trained in multiple departments so that I could be of value to the store as a whole.
